March 10, 2018 - By Richard Conner 
Seaward Management Limited Partnership increased its stake in Wal Mart Stores (WMT) by 20.88%   Seaward Management Limited Partnership bought 84,359 shares as the company’s stock rose 13.55% with the market. The institutional investor held 488,443 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $38.17M, up from 404,084   Seaward Management Limited Partnership who had been investing in Wal Mart Stores for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $262.82B market cap company. The stock increased 0.91% or $0.8   $88.72. About 9.75 million shares traded. Walmart Inc. (NYSE:WMT) has risen 13.83%   underperformed by 2.87% the S&P500. 
Highlander Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Oracle Corp Com (ORCL) by 333.74%   Highlander Capital Management Llc bought 8,300 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.35% with the market. The institutional investor held 10,787 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $522,000, up from 2,487   Highlander Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Oracle Corp Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $219.28 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.61% or $0.84   $52.97. About 16.22 million shares traded. Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) has risen 14.08%   underperformed by 2.62% the S&P500. 
Highlander Capital Management Llc, which manages about $131.70M and $128.11 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Parker Hannifin Corp (NYSE:PH) by 3,000 shares to 3,425 shares, valued at $599,000 in 2017Q3, according to the filing. 
Among 38 analysts covering Oracle ( NYSE:ORCL ), 28 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 10 Hold. Therefore 74% are positive. Oracle had 105 analyst reports since July 30, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was maintained by Benchmark on Friday, April 28 with “Buy”. The stock of Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) has “Buy” rating given on Wednesday, June 21 by Drexel Hamilton. The stock has “Market Perform” rating by BMO Capital Markets on Friday, January 8. The stock of Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) earned “Buy” rating by Cowen & Co on Monday, September 11. Goldman Sachs maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Wednesday, March 16 report. As per Friday, August 25, the company rating was maintained by RBC Capital Markets. The company was maintained on Friday, September 15 by Jefferies. Stifel Nicolaus maintained the shares of ORCL in report on Monday, July 24 with “Buy” rating. The firm has “Buy” rating by RBC Capital Markets given on Sunday, July 23. Rosenblatt maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Thursday, June 22 report.
